topic: In a village well, the echo starts answering questions before you finish asking them.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Echo That Answered First

shots.narration: The well answered before I finished asking.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated Pakistani haveli courtyard at midnight, lantern between Bashir and Saad, no writing.
shots.action: Bashir leans toward Saad over his brass lantern.
shots.mood: Warm lantern light surrounded by deep blue shadows and low fog.

shots.narration: Bashir told Saad about a well outside his old village.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated dry village square in Pakistan, circular stone well beneath a bare tree, no writing.
shots.action: Bashir approaches the well carrying his brass lantern.
shots.mood: Empty moonlit square, dusty ground, long crooked shadows.

shots.narration: [whispers] That night, something below copied every sound except his footsteps.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, stone well rim beside Bashir's sandals, brass lantern illuminating loose pebbles.
shots.mood: Still dust, black well opening, cold moonlight against amber glow.

shots.narration: He began, 'Is anyone—' and the echo answered, 'Here.'
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, view across a rough stone well rim toward Bashir's lantern-lit face.
shots.mood: Heavy darkness below, sharply lit grey beard, tense eyes.

shots.narration: Before he asked how deep, it answered, 'Deep enough.'
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, view down the stone shaft past Bashir's lantern toward distant black water.
shots.action: A single ripple expands across the water.
shots.mood: Wet stone, tiny amber reflection, immense surrounding darkness.

shots.narration: [sighs] He stepped away, but his shadow stayed beside the well.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, moonlit village square with Bashir several steps from the stone well.
shots.action: Bashir backs away from his shadow fixed against the rim.
shots.mood: Unnatural separated shadow, pale fog, trembling lantern glow.

shots.narration: Then the bucket rose, though nobody touched the rope.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, old wooden pulley above the village well, plain rope and weathered wooden bucket.
shots.action: The bucket rises above the stone rim.
shots.mood: Moonlit rope fibers, black opening, suspended mist.

shots.narration: Inside lay his white cap, still dripping.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bucket suspended beside the well, wet white cap inside, bareheaded Bashir behind it.
shots.action: Bashir touches the top of his bare head.
shots.mood: Bright droplets against dark wood, stunned face in lantern light.

shots.narration: [whispers] Before he asked who took it, the echo said, 'Saad.'
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Bashir beside the suspended bucket and open well, brown shawl tightly wrapped.
shots.action: Bashir turns toward the well opening.
shots.mood: Lantern light grazing rough stone, dense shadows beneath the pulley.

shots.narration: Bashir lowered his lantern to see who had answered.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, view inside the well shaft, Bashir visible above the circular opening.
shots.action: Bashir lowers his brass lantern toward the water.
shots.mood: Descending amber light, slick stone walls, motionless black surface.

shots.narration: Saad opened his eyes beneath the water; they hadn't met yet.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of black well water, Saad's face beneath the surface, dark green hoodie fading into darkness.
shots.action: Saad opens his eyes beneath the perfectly still water.
shots.mood: Pale submerged face, tiny lantern reflection in wide eyes, oppressive darkness.

shots.narration: [surprised] Tonight, Saad's torch revealed tracks leading to an abandoned station.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, original haveli courtyard, impossible railway tracks extending through fog toward an empty station, no signs or writing.
shots.action: Saad sweeps his torch beam across the railway tracks.
shots.mood: Cold torchlight on steel rails, distant empty platform, lantern glow behind them

episode.endHook: Why do railway tracks now lead out of Bashir's courtyard?
episode.description: By his lantern, Bashir Chacha tells Saad about a village well that answered unfinished questions. But one answer seems to have followed him home. A fictional spooky story set in Pakistan.
